The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9b9236021eab20eb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 27-28. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: For a loop let k, l be the numbers of its visited Tutte triangles with blue, respectively red base. Call the side adjacent to the blue bases (i.e. toward the blue endpoints of crossed links) its blue side, and let u be the mn-area of that side of the loop on the sphere, including everything nested there. Write ds(v) = s2v−2 exp(−s2/v) for 27 s, v > 0, extended by zero at v = 0. Then X2n Zn(4) ∼ 8π2 n2 log2 n , lim n E ∑︂ loops ψ(k/Bn, u) = 1 2π2 ∫︂ ∞ 0 ∫︂ 1 0 ψ(s, v) ds dv s5 ds(v)ds(1 − v). (3.1) Here ψ is continuous with compact support in (0, ∞) × [0, 1], extended by zero at length zero. This does not assert that loop lengths can be read from a geometric limit or that every macroscopic loop has k in a range of order Bn.
